cards.ex: She dedicates her free time to mentoring underprivileged kids.
cards.exUz: U bo'sh vaqtini kam ta'minlangan bolalarga murabbiylik qilishga bag'ishlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Biror xayrli ish uchun vaqt sarflash, ko'ngilli ravishda vaqt bag'ishlash.

cards.ex: We actively support the cause of environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Biz atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish maqsadini faol qo'llab-quvvatlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror xayrli maqsadga yordam berish, uni himoya qilish.

cards.ex: Her altruistic endeavors have transformed the lives of many.
cards.exUz: Uning xudbinliksiz harakatlari ko'pchilikning hayotini o'zgartirdi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqalarga foyda keltirish uchun qilingan harakatlar, o'z manfaatini ko'zlamaslik.

cards.ex: He's lending his expertise to the charity's marketing efforts.
cards.exUz: U xayriya tashkilotining marketing ishlariga o'z tajribasini ulashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: O'z bilim va tajribasini boshqalarga bepul yordam berish uchun taqdim etish.

cards.ex: She's been championing the cause of animal rights for years.
cards.exUz: U bir necha yillardan beri hayvonlar huquqlarini himoya qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsadni faol qo'llab-quvvatlash va himoya qilish.

cards.ex: They give selflessly to those in need, expecting nothing in return.
cards.exUz: Ular hech narsa kutmasdan, muhtojlarga samimiy yordam berishadi.
cards.uzDef: O'z manfaatini o'ylamasdan, chin dildan yordam berish.

cards.ex: His donation was a significant philanthropic gesture.
cards.exUz: Uning xayriyasi muhim saxovatpesha imo-ishora edi.
cards.uzDef: Xayriya maqsadida qilingan harakat, saxovatlilik belgisi.

cards.ex: She took the initiative to organize a fundraising event.
cards.exUz: U xayriya tadbirini tashkil qilish tashabbusini ko'rsatdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishni boshlash uchun birinchi qadamni tashlash, tashabbuskor bo'lish.

cards.ex: He's a very community-minded individual who always tries to help.
cards.exUz: U juda jamiyatparvar shaxs, doimo yordam berishga harakat qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyat manfaatlarini o'ylaydigan, jamiyatga foyda keltirishga intiladigan.

cards.ex: She worked in a voluntary capacity at the local shelter.
cards.exUz: U mahalliy boshpanada ko'ngilli sifatida ishlagan.
cards.uzDef: Pulsiz, o'z xohishi bilan qilingan ish, ko'ngillilik asosida.

cards.ex: The company decided to donate resources to the disaster relief effort.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya ofat oqibatlarini bartaraf etish uchun resurslar xayriya qilishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Pul, mahsulot, yoki boshqa narsalarni xayriya maqsadida berish.

cards.ex: His selfless service to the community earned him great respect.
cards.exUz: Uning jamiyatga xudbinliksiz xizmati unga katta hurmat keltirdi.
cards.uzDef: O'z manfaatini ko'zlamasdan, boshqalarga yordam berishga qaratilgan xizmat.

cards.ex: We're making these sacrifices for the greater good.
cards.exUz: Biz bu qurbonliklarni umumiy manfaat uchun qilmoqdamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ko'pchilikning manfaatini ko'zlab, hamma uchun yaxshi bo'lishi uchun.

cards.ex: The good Samaritan stopped to help the stranded motorist.
cards.exUz: Yaxshi samariyalik yo'lda qolib ketgan haydovchiga yordam berish uchun to'xtadi.
cards.uzDef: Begona odamga yordam beradigan, rahmdil inson.

cards.ex: Everyone got stuck in cleaning up after the event.
cards.exUz: Tadbirdan keyin tozalashga hamma ishtiyoq bilan kirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Biror ishga juda g'ayrat bilan kirishish, ishtiyoq bilan boshlash.

cards.ex: Young people are becoming increasingly socially conscious.
cards.exUz: Yoshlar tobora ijtimoiy ongli bo'lib bormoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ijtimoiy muammolarni biladigan va ularni hal qilishga harakat qiladigan.

cards.ex: Healthcare workers are on the front lines of the pandemic response.
cards.exUz: Tibbiyot xodimlari pandemiya reaksiyasining oldingi saflarida.
cards.uzDef: Muammoga qarshi kurashda birinchi bo'lib harakat qiladigan, oldingi safda bo'lish.

cards.ex: They're trying to rally support for the new community center.
cards.exUz: Ular yangi jamiyat markazi uchun qo'llab-quvvatlashni safarbar qilmoqchi.
cards.uzDef: Biror maqsad uchun odamlarni qo'llab-quvvatlashga chaqirish, safarbar qilish.

cards.ex: The scholarship program aims to give a leg up to disadvantaged students.
cards.exUz: Stipendiya dasturi kam ta'minlangan talabalarga yordam berishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin ahvolda bo'lgan odamga imkoniyat yaratish orqali yordam berish.

cards.ex: The beach cleanup was a massive volunteer effort.
cards.exUz: Sohilni tozalash katta ko'ngillilar harakati edi.
cards.uzDef: Ko'ngillilarning birgalikdagi harakati, pul evaziga emas, ixtiyoriy ravishda qilingan ish.

cards.ex: He offered a helping hand to the new neighbor.
cards.exUz: U yangi qo'shniga yordam qo'lini taklif qildi.
cards.uzDef: Yordam, ko'mak, qo'llab-quvvatlash.

cards.ex: Her act of kindness made a huge difference in his day.
cards.exUz: Uning mehribonlik harakati uning kunida katta o'zgarish qildi.
cards.uzDef: Mehribonlik bilan qilingan harakat, yaxshilik qilish.

cards.ex: We donate goods to the local homeless shelter every year.
cards.exUz: Biz har yili mahalliy uysizlar boshpanasiga tovarlar xayriya qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz yoki ortiqcha bo'lgan narsalarni xayriya uchun berish.

cards.ex: They offer free counseling services at no cost to the community.
cards.exUz: Ular jamiyatga hech qanday to'lovsiz bepul maslahat xizmatlarini taklif qilishadi.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday to'lovsiz, bepul, tekinga.

cards.ex: I wanted to be part of something bigger than myself.
cards.exUz: Men o'zimdan kattaroq narsaning bir qismi bo'lishni xohladim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning ishtirokchisi bo'lish, biror guruh yoki harakatga qo'shilish.

cards.ex: We need to tackle the issue of poverty in our city.
cards.exUz: Biz shahrimizdagi kambag'allik muammosiga yechim topishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni hal qilishga harakat qilish, unga qarshi kurashish.

cards.ex: She was helped when she was young, and now she gives back tenfold.
cards.exUz: U yoshligida yordam olgan, endi esa u o'n barobar qaytarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Olingan yaxshilikka nisbatan ancha ko'p yaxshilik qaytarish.

cards.ex: Volunteering has a massive feel-good factor.
cards.exUz: Ko'ngillilikda katta xursandchilik omili bor.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi ish qilgandan keyin paydo bo'ladigan xursandchilik va qoniqish hissi.

cards.ex: I get a buzz out of helping people.
cards.exUz: Men odamlarga yordam berishdan zavq olaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsadan katta zavq olish, qoniqish his qilish.

cards.ex: The charity provides a vital support system for families in need.
cards.exUz: Xayriya tashkiloti muhtoj oilalar uchun muhim qo'llab-quvvatlash tizimini ta'minlaydi.
cards.uzDef: Yordam va ko'mak beradigan odamlar guruhi yoki tashkilot.
